note: Files under a path that a route line owns (tools/allnets/test_all.py OWNED) which the integration changed AFTER merging the line, each with the git blob it must have and the tip of the line it was changed from. `test_all.py --identity` holds every such file to its blob and every other owned byte to its line's merged tip. The `changes` list is written by `test_all.py --identity-record DECISION` from the committed tree, never by hand; the text of a decision is written by hand in a reviewed commit. A line that is merged again at a new tip needs its records made again (a record against another tip fails the check).

decisions.launch-limits-2026-11-19: Owner, 2026-11-19: the bridge windows and caps are delegated to the coordinator, the external audit is done after launch, and the key ceremony goes ahead. Coordinator, 2026-11-19: Ethereum cap 500,000 USDC and window 50,000 USDC per 24 h; Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet and Linea cap 250,000 and window 25,000; every other route unchanged. Agent 410 (round 20) applied it in the integration tree because the limits became a field of the EVM launch registry and of the owner's ceremony kit: tools/evm-nets (registry record, generator, tests, fork rehearsal), the three networks' generated deployment files, and the ceremony kit, its test and its document (limits held value by value; audit wording; the state of the L2). Base and BNB Smart Chain files are not changed. docs/BRIDGE-ALLNETS.md section 7.
decisions.l2-repin-and-queue-bound-2026-11-19: Coordinator, 2026-11-19 (round 20, agent 421), two launch blockers of the Ethereum bUSDC bridge found by agent 410. F410-2: the signers' L2 pin set named the L2 release of 2026-11-03 while the L2 went live with the release the owner signed on 2026-11-17; the new pin set mainnet-v3 (tools/signatario-stable/l2_finality.py) replaces the name mainnet-v2 in every operator template, so the generated operator templates of the three networks, ops/routes.json (the pin name in the list of public facts a rendered config may hold, and every route's source_rev with its status text: an operator bundle ships the daemons and templates of source_rev, which was the audit candidate cc2511a / 9187656 with the pins of 2026-11-03 and the relayer gas ceiling from before the fee schedule, so the re-pin reaches an operator only through a new source_rev), what stated the old revision (ops/test_bundle.py, the F381-1 control of ops/rehearse_containers.py, the table of docs/OPERATOR-PACKAGES.md) and tools/evm-nets/test_launch_r17.py changed; no file of a held route's line is changed (the Bitcoin mint-signer template keeps the superseded name and is refused until its own line takes the current one); notes.l2Build of the generated token configs names the live release; the ceremony document states the prerequisite as closed. F410-1: minimum deposit 25 USDC on Arbitrum One and OP Mainnet (21 before; the minimum burn stays 20) because with the 25,000 USDC bucket of the launch limits the honest mint queue with one more delay of execution lag exceeded MAX_PENDING of the frozen L2 token; the bound became a rule of tools/evm-nets/launch.py (registry) and tools/deploy-pontes/vault_pontes.py, so tools/evm-nets (registry, launch.py, generator, tests) and the two networks' generated files changed. Base and BNB Smart Chain files are not changed. docs/BRIDGE-ALLNETS.md section 7.3; docs/BRIDGE-V3-OPERATOR-RUNBOOK.md section 3a. A file that was already recorded under launch-limits-2026-11-19 keeps that label (the record tool keeps the first decision of a file) and its blob now carries both changes.
